uncited: *   **Feature Mask:** Binary volume marking voxels at boundaries between two segments.
*   **Distance Transform:** Unsigned distance to the feature mask.
*   **Normal Volume:** Quantized categorical values representing normals.
Leaf nodes store normals (for the second graph) or lighting contributions.
**Distance Transform:** Compute an unsigned distance transform to these features using the method of Schneider et al. [45].
**Lighting Propagation:** Evaluate a shading model at each leaf.
Rendering is accelerated by lookup tables.
Exact time/memory complexity not given in the sources.
It builds on [Volumetric Lighting via Gradient Normals](1625-volumetric-lighting-via-gradient-normals.md) by specifically handling categorical labels.
